resources.string: Creates and manages the work profile used as the Island. VictorLaunch becomes the profile owner of that profile so it can clone, freeze, hide, pause, and resume apps inside it.
Allows an app signed with the VictorLaunch key to read the shared fleet theme. Differently signed fleet apps must still pass package+cert verification.
Optional. Lets a VictorLaunch home gesture lock the screen. It does not read screen content or what you type.
